permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records a short audio clip from the glasses microphone to identify the song playing.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Falls back to the phone microphone when the glasses mic is unavailable (e.g., desktop dev or simulator).

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends audio to AudD or ACRCloud to identify songs, fetches lyrics from LRCLIB and lyrics.ovh, and scrobbles recognized tracks to Last.fm.
